name: Uxbridge–Stouffville rail connections
description: Train-connecting services north of Unionville/Mount Joy, including Uxbridge, Goodwood, Stouffville and the station first called Lincolnville and then Old Elm. Route 71 contains the associated Union-bound bus service.

timeline.event: The original archived GTFS contains route 70 and branches 70A, 70B and 70E.
The original timetable documents 70 Uxbridge–Stouffville–Unionville and shorter branches including 70B and 70D.
Lincolnville GO was renamed Old Elm GO; the name change preceded the physical station relocation.
The timetable uses the Old Elm name while serving the original Bethesda Road station site.
Old Elm service moved to the replacement station southwest of the original site.

sources.title: Original GO Transit GTFS archived January 11, 2016; use calendar validity, not retrieval date
Town of Whitchurch-Stouffville 2021 Year in Review: Lincolnville renamed October 16, 2021
GO relocates Old Elm station, October 17, 2023 — Transit Toronto

gaps: The first date the separate route 70 number was introduced has not been located. Earlier Uxbridge connecting buses in Table 71 should not automatically be relabelled 70.
The 2016 and later GTFS snapshots preserve additional exact branch and local-stop variants.
These are documented dated snapshots. Changes between snapshots, temporary diversions and every historical local stop have not all been recovered.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
